## Summary

Started 4.1 and stopped short of authoring, because building the initiative inventory exposed two problems that would have contaminated the set. First, the frozen ceiling was computed on the wrong basis: section 6.2 derived N max equals 70 from LIVE initiative counts, but D31 came later and plants only into the snapshot clones, which sit behind their sources — sofar 34 live against 26 usable in the clone. True ceiling is 66. D32's N equals 60 is unaffected and stands, but a later session sizing from 70 would overrun the plantable supply. Second and more serious, D27 governs how many constraints THIS BENCHMARK plants per initiative and is silent on how many the record already had. Eight of the 60 targets carry native standing constraints — brillo at 10, 4, 3 and 1, and all four crisperflow initiatives at 22, 7, 5 and 4 — so D27's stated ladder, P showing no standing-constraints block and R showing one, holds for 52 and is false for 8. crisperflow app-target would run P at 22 and R at 23. It cannot be fixed by selection: crisperflow has no zero-rule initiative, moving those slots to brillo breaches the 40 percent cap, and planting only in zero-rule initiatives forces N below what D29 and D32 forbid reopening. Ruled as D33 to measure it rather than engineer it away, stamping each constraint with its initiative's native rule count and publishing the rate split. Froze the 60-slot inventory with its selection basis stated, and recorded that four hosts have zero margin.

## Next action

Author the 60 constraints against the frozen inventory, one per initiative into the snapshot clones, starting with the zero-margin hosts so a screen failure there surfaces while brillo can still absorb the slot.
